answer: The defence rests on lighthouse keeper log with lamp maintenance history: lamp hours logged at one lighthouse for years. Forging 260 of these means building 260 separate lamp histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The reef check runs in the open: 260 fakes pay the full price 260 times, one honest agent pays once, and the prism trail in the ledger makes the jade cost visible to everyone.
